/^cd "c:\\Users\\kitkon\\\.gemini\\antigravity\\playground\\vacant-exoplanet" && python -c "
with open\('index\.html', 'r', encoding='utf-8'\) as f:
    content = f\.read\(\)

# Find the script tag end and </head> markers
marker1 = '<script src=\\"https://unpkg\.com/lightweight-charts/dist/lightweight-charts\.standalone\.production\.js\\"></script>'
marker2 = '</head>'

idx1 = content\.index\(marker1\) \+ len\(marker1\)
idx2 = content\.index\(marker2\)

# Replace everything between the two markers with just a newline
new_content = content\[:idx1\] \+ '\\n' \+ content\[idx2:\]

with open\('index\.html', 'w', encoding='utf-8'\) as f:
    f\.write\(new_content\)
print\('Done'\)
"
$/
